artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan collapsing the two deploy engines onto the manifest-driven loader: scratch-tree regression harness first (red baseline), table-driven copier collapse, force/resync mode plus a single manager.resync_all bulk entry point (absorbing the picker's third Kahn's-algorithm reimplementation), preserved-state snapshot/restore covering .syncprotect paths, corrected regenerate ordering with a wired backup->wipe->restore->clear sequence, entry-point consolidation retiring load_all_globally and the dead is_load_all branch, manifest-driven verification with content-hash parity across all 11 provides.* categories routed through verify-deploy.sh's existing findings accumulator, prose corrections, and end-to-end execution of the union verification bar. Includes 7 dependency waves, 6 scope hypotheses, 2 declared atomic-batch phases, and a rollback path that ships force-resync plus full verification without the wipe if the wipe cannot be made safe.
Research report confirming all six root causes with file:line evidence (carried forward from the research dispatch).

memory_candidates.content: When extending a verification gate's coverage in this repo, new findings MUST be emitted through verify-deploy.sh's existing FINDINGS_LIST accumulator (the additive --findings mode, one normalized 'FINDING <gate> <text>' line per finding, with an optional override argument for messages embedding a numeric count). The inter-cycle redeploy checkpoint diffs a pre/post baseline of that findings set: a finding present in both baselines is reported loudly but does not defer a multi-task /orchestrate batch, while a newly introduced one still defers. Broadening verification coverage WITHOUT routing through this accumulator converts multi-task orchestration into run-one-then-defer, because every pre-existing failure in the newly covered surface reads as new. Findings text must also stay stable across runs to be diffable -- hence the count-override argument.
